prompt: How many times in the history of the Summer Olympic Games has the United States not topped the medal table?
answer: 10 times. The United States topped the Summer Olympic medal table 19 times out of 30 Games, but appeared in only 29 because it boycotted 1980; therefore, it did not top the table in 10 Games.
